**Session summary: brain**

## Goal
Full autonomous SDD pipeline for issue #473 (approval signature lands on the diff, not the issue): explore → propose → spec+design → tasks → 3-slice feature-branch-chain implementation → PRs → bounded cold-review loops (max 3 rounds), token-economy mode.

## Accomplished
- Chain delivered, all cold-review verdicts APPROVE: PR #502 (slice 1, parser extraction → tracker base; approved round 1 + one drift-guard FIELD-axis fix), PR #503 (slice 2, evaluateSignedDecision reader; REVISE round 1 with 3 verified MAJORs → fixed `38fd26f` → APPROVE round 2), PR #504 (slice 3, brain:approve CLI + ADR draft; REVISE r1 GitLab credential split → fix + orchestrator-caught mrList SITE gap `12610d2` → REVISE r2 same bug class recreated on GitHub via whoami token → provider-conditional fix `a376383` → APPROVE round 3 with live BRANCH-axis mutations caught). Hit exactly the 3-round cap on #504, no loop.
- Suite: 2875/2875. Branches: tracker `feat/issue-473-approval-signature-on-diff` (base), s1/s2/s3 chained. SDD artifacts materialized to hybrid (openspec/changes/issue-473-approval-signature-on-diff/) after engram-only mode collided with repo:check's openspec-incomplete rule. ADR-0026 Amendment 2 draft at brain-drafts/adr-0026-amendment-2.draft.md (.draft.md so destinationFor() returns null).

## Discoveries
- The red-proof doctrine validated empirically across the loop: every REVISE round found its principal defect inside the previous repair (GitLab split → unconditional threading → GitHub split → provider ternary needing BRANCH-axis matrix).
- github.mjs whoami({token}) overrides identity while the other github verbs ignore token — any caller threading gitlabApiConfig unconditionally into whoami has divergent identity vs post. Audit: approve/cli.mjs was the only such exposure; identity.mjs guards by provider (different invariant: BRAIN_REVIEWER_TOKEN, deliberate).
- vcs.PROVIDER is a hardcoded module literal, config case-mismatch throws at getVcs — the ternary can't be spoofed; unknown provider falls to {} = fail-safe ambient.

## Next Steps (human)
1. Review+merge the chain inward: #504 → s2, #503 → s1, #502 → tracker.
2. H.1: promote ADR-0026 Amendment 2 on the tracker branch — in-file edit per §1c (paste-ready blocks in the draft) + HOME.md line + AGENT_PLATFORM=antigravity regen, ONE commit, human-authored.
3. Open tracker→main PR (agent can prepare; carries `decision` label; ~581 gate-counted lines < 1000 lite budget), then H.2: re-apply status:approved on #473 AFTER the last push (actor-check re-arm — the friction this change retires), merge.
- Residual noted by round 3 (pre-existing, out of scope): no try/catch around getVcsFn in cli.mjs entry — raw stack on malformed provider config. Candidate micro-ticket.

## Relevant Files
- brain/scripts/review/lib/{yaml-block,decision-block}.mjs — shared primitives + brain-decision/1 (s1)
- brain/scripts/vcs/actor-check.mjs — evaluateSignedDecision peer evidence source (s2)
- brain/scripts/approve/cli.mjs — brain:approve CLI, SIGN word, provider-conditional transport (s3)
- openspec/changes/issue-473-approval-signature-on-diff/ — SDD artifacts + ADR draft
- engram topics sdd/issue-473-approval-signature-on-diff/* — full artifact trail
